name: io.github.alexanderolvera/dfhack-mcp
title: Dwarf Fortress (DFHack)
description: MCP server exposing a live Dwarf Fortress fort to an AI agent as curated, semantic tools

environmentVariables.name: DFHACK_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Host running DFHack's remote RPC server. Defaults to 127.0.0.1.

environmentVariables.name: DFHACK_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Port for DFHack's remote RPC server. Defaults to 5000.

environmentVariables.name: DFHACK_MCP_ACTUATORS
environmentVariables.description: Set to any value to expose the write tools. Unset, the server is read-only.
